title: New York Cheesecake
description: New York Cheesecake is a dish from United States prepared with graham cracker crumbs, cream cheese, chicken egg, sour cream. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Shape, press or roll the prepared dough or mixture into portions appropriate to this dish.
Beat the listed ingredients until pale and light; ensure butter and eggs are at room temperature when specified.
Bake the cheesecake gently around 150–160°C, preferably in a water bath, until edges set and the center still has a slight wobble; cool gradually to avoid cracks.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 240 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
